source: sars-guide:SARS PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Guide for Employers iro Employees Tax 2027, Revision 1 p. 9-10 (annual equivalent of part-period pay; a part period as its share of days, 3 of 7 = 0.4285) and p. 13; apportionment basis: wave-7 ruling 13 (monthly working days, weekly calendar days), scope ruling 19
notes: Review #1901 H1, ruling 19: a leaver's split salary is measured against their employed window, so it sums to full pay. Employed since 1 March 2020, last day Wednesday 15 July 2026 (window 1-15 July: 11 working days), age 40. Basic R4 000 to Thursday 9 July (7 of 11 working days: 4 000 x 7 / 11 = 2 545.454 -> 2 545.45), R4 800 from Friday 10 July, open-ended as a run reads it (4 of 11: 4 800 x 4 / 11 = 1 745.454 -> 1 745.45). Gross 4 290.90; PAYE R0 (under the threshold, G21 p. 13). UIF 1% = 42.91 each side; SDL 42.91; net 4 247.99. Measured against the calendar month (23 days) it paid 1 217.39 + 834.78 = 2 052.17, below a leaver with no raise (R4 000).
